user.title: The Boring Camera Card
user.description: Optional go2rtc settings. Leave everything empty to let the card find go2rtc automatically. Cameras are added afterwards, one by one, with **Add camera**.

data_description.go2rtc_server_lan: Only needed if go2rtc does not run on the same host as Home Assistant, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:1984.
data_description.go2rtc_ingress: Only for the go2rtc add-on. Lets the card reach go2rtc from outside through Home Assistant.
data_description.go2rtc_server: Alternative address of go2rtc when you are not at home.
data_description.go2rtc_token: Only needed if your own reverse proxy in front of go2rtc requires a token.

abort.single_instance_allowed: The integration is already set up. Add more cameras from its page with **Add camera**.

user.title: Choose the camera
user.description: Everything else (streams, recordings folder, doorbell settings) is looked up automatically in the next step.

details.title: Check the camera settings

data_description.go2rtc_url: Name of the stream in go2rtc.
data_description.go2rtc_url_sub: Saves data in the normal view; fullscreen switches to the main stream.
data_description.media_folder: Folder in the media browser with this camera's recordings. Leave empty for live view only.
data_description.mic: Needs a camera with a back channel, e.g. a video doorbell.
